scan_semantics: At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.

formal_properties.explanation: Emergency stop forces safe outputs immediately.
Reset acceptance and motor start cannot share one scan.
Reset requires released Start and Stop.
A subsequent permitted start energizes the motor.

atomic_propositions.Start: Start request Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.Stop: Normal stop request Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.EStopNC: TRUE means emergency stop released Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.Reset: Reset request Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.Run: Spindle run command Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.ResetRequired: Restart inhibition latch Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.first: True only on the first invocation after resetting the FB instance.
